entries.a72d80b978baa604: A business that manufactures and sells shovels, and sells outdoor goods and construction and agricultural equipment. The company manufactures and sells shovels, and its subsidiary Kunitomi Sangyo Co., Ltd. manufactures shovel handles (raw materials) and wooden products. Outdoor goods and construction and agricultural equipment are sales of purchased merchandise, excluding products manufactured by subsidiaries. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,311 million, and the number of employees was 98.
entries.a96cfb6629656095: As its business strategy, it aims to raise profitability by strengthening sales capabilities to expand revenue and reducing total costs. With an eye to a declining birthrate and aging population, it is developing products that are lighter and reduce labor for tools and emphasize functionality for regional and special uses, and it will strengthen its overseas and EC businesses and develop new sales channels and markets. Overseas, it has export results to 18 countries, and it will develop products suited to local specifications with a view to expanding sales in Europe, centered on Germany and the United Kingdom. At the Sakai factory, it will renovate and upgrade production equipment to strengthen the production system and improve production efficiency.
